messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Icarus Health hit a 3x embed spike in the last 24h and their renewal is in ~45d. I want a short QBR-ready snapshot focused on token economics + immediate guardrails. Can we triage? :rotating_light:
devin_finops: on it. can you share the current forecast window and any recent config changes?
ashley_csm: icarus onboarded last month with 2 model endpoints, one for search/embeds and one for chat. they enabled batch_inference=true yesterday (could explain burst). no formal quota in place yet.
raj_engineer: batch_inference will send big payloads. i can surface per-route TPS and the per-request token distribution. pulling logs now.
maria_cs: thx. quick ask: 1) 14-day projected token burn vs committed 2) suggested temporary throttles/alerts we can push 3) enablement checklist to reduce cost without hurting UX.
devin_finops: preliminary 14-day projection (rough): current daily avg tokens=2.1M -> with 3x spike potential = 6.3M/day. projected 14d = ~88M tokens. committed = 60M. gap = ~28M. i'll formalize and attach a clean table for QBR.
raj_engineer: logs show 70% of extra tokens from embed route `/v1/embeddings` with avg tokens/request jumping from 1.2k -> 3.8k after batch flag. Most requests come from a single API key (team-icarus-prod).
ashley_csm: pinging customer to confirm batch change — they said they enabled to reduce latency for bulk ingestion. they didn't realize token multiplier.
maria_cs: ok. immediate mitigations: 1) temp soft-limit on team-icarus-prod at 200 reqs/min 2) add usage-alert at 2x daily baseline and 3) enable per-route quantization suggestion in Optimize. can ops/eng apply?
raj_engineer: can do soft-limit. propose adding a rate limiter config: 
```
rate_limit:
  key: team-icarus-prod
  window: 60s
  limit: 200
  action: warn_then_throttle
```
I'll put it in staging then promote.
sam_ops: i'll schedule the alert and notify CS channel. creating an alert rule now.
alerts-bot: Created alert rule #ICR-usage-spike. Trigger: daily_tokens > 2 * baseline(14d). Notification: #customer-success + email to maria_cs.
devin_finops: QBR note: if spike sustains for 14 days, estimated overage ~$1,900 at current rates. if we apply short-term quantization to embeddings (~8-bit), expected token-cost reduction ~35-40% for that route. need sign-off for recommending quantization to the customer.
maria_cs: capture that as an action item: "Quantization recommendation + tradeoffs". ashley, follow up with customer for opt-in window and monitor quality.
ashley_csm: copying: @IcarusOps — we recommend a short test of reduced precision embeddings for a subset of records to validate quality drop. can you allocate a small test dataset?
IcarusOps: (via DM) will provide 5k records. aim to test tomorrow morning.
raj_engineer: added a one-line dashboard snippet for QBR: 
```
Icarus Health — Cost Snapshot
- 7d avg tokens/day: 2.1M
- 24h spike tokens/day: 6.3M
- committed: 60M (14d equivalent ~ 840k/day)
- projected 14d burn: 88M
- recommended actions: soft-limit, quantize embeddings test, enable per-route caching for repeated vectors
```
maria_cs: perfect. last thing — renewal risk tag? set as "monitoring" (low-medium) unless spike continues after mitigations. add to QBR slide deck under Risks -> Actioned.
devin_finops: i'll add an estimated overage line and potential discount ask scenario if they want more committed capacity.
ashley_csm: logging action items: 1) raj -> apply soft-limit in prod (ETA 30m) 2) sam -> alert rule confirmation and escalation path 3) devin -> cost table for QBR 4) ashley -> customer enablement for quantization test.
maria_cs: thanks team. keep replies short in this thread — i'll assemble slides. :thumbsup:
